# GrubTub Rentals

> Private BBQ donut boat rentals on Padanaram Harbor in South Dartmouth, Massachusetts, about 15 minutes from New Bedford. Self-drive, no boating license needed. Up to 8 people per boat, 3-hour rentals, season May 1 to September 30.

- Address: 75 Gulf Road, South Dartmouth, MA 02748
- Phone: (774) 264-4904
- Email: grubtubrentals@gmail.com
- Prices (whole boat, plus taxes and fees): Morning 9:30 AM-12:30 PM $250; Afternoon 1:00-4:00 PM $250; Sunset 4:30-7:30 PM $300; Wednesday Concert Night 5:30-8:30 PM $350 (June 16 to Aug 25)
- Driver must be 21+ with photo ID and stay sober. Optional licensed captain add-on ($150, max 6 guests).
- Add-ons: propane grill $15, ice-packed cooler $7, Party Bundle $53, Dockside Delivery $26.50, Trip Protection +15%
- Runs rain or shine (canopy on every boat); cancels only for storms or high winds with full refund or credit.
- Rated 5.0 on Google.
- Good for: birthdays, bachelorette parties, families, date ideas, team outings, things to do in Dartmouth and New Bedford MA.
